clauses.section: One Off Use – 2. Never give personal or sensitive information to AI bots.
clauses.original_text: Never use prompts containing: Personal information (yours or anyone else’s) such as names, addresses, or any information that could be used to identify someone. Organisation-specific sensitive information, such as information related to a restructure. Confidential information, such as details about commercial contracts.
clauses.requirement: no personal, sensitive or confidential data in prompts
clauses.purpose: prevent disclosure to AI providers and other users
clauses.applicable_systems: generative AI bots and tools (e.g. ChatGPT, BingAI, Google Bard, DALL-E)
clauses.interpretation_notes: Bullet list flattened. Related test: if the information is not clearly appropriate for open public access, do not enter it.

clauses.section: One Off Use – 3. Always check your work.
clauses.original_text: You must always check any answers or outputs you get. Don’t assume it is correct, and don’t use it without reading it first.
clauses.requirement: read and verify outputs before use
clauses.applicable_systems: generative AI bots and tools (e.g. ChatGPT, BingAI, Google Bard, DALL-E)
clauses.interpretation_notes: Document explains hallucinations and data bias as reasons.

clauses.section: What are the risks associated with them? – 3. Data Protection Implications
clauses.original_text: The legal implications of using an AI tool or bot must be carefully considered before it is used to handle personal data (or business confidential data). Please get advice from the Data Protection Advice Team (…) before using AI.
clauses.object: use of AI to handle personal or confidential data
clauses.requirement: legal assessment and data-protection advice before AI handles personal data
clauses.condition: AI used to handle personal or business-confidential data
clauses.applicable_systems: generative AI bots and tools (e.g. ChatGPT, BingAI, Google Bard, DALL-E)

clauses.section: Using AI bots or other AI services within a regular workflow
clauses.original_text: A DPIA must be completed and discussed with the Data Protection Advice Team.
clauses.object: use of AI bots or APIs within a business process
clauses.requirement: DPIA before embedding AI in a workflow
clauses.condition: AI bots used as part of a business process or via an API within a flow of work
clauses.applicable_systems: generative AI bots and tools (e.g. ChatGPT, BingAI, Google Bard, DALL-E)
clauses.interpretation_notes: Also stated in the risks section: a Data Privacy Impact Assessment must be completed where AI replaces, is added to, or creates a business process.

clauses.section: FAQ – I’ve accidentally uploaded some personal or sensitive data into a bot, what should I do?
clauses.original_text: You need to complete a data breach form and the team can discuss next steps.
clauses.object: accidental upload of personal or sensitive data into an AI bot
clauses.condition: personal or sensitive data uploaded to a bot
clauses.applicable_systems: generative AI bots and tools (e.g. ChatGPT, BingAI, Google Bard, DALL-E)
clauses.interpretation_notes: Phrased as an FAQ answer ('You need to'), read as MUST.
